cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
db = fs.offline_featurestore_name
sql = f'''SELECT a.row_id AS row_id, ROUND(a.a_val + b.b_val, 6) AS col_sum
FROM \`{db}\`.\`rawa2962af_1\` a
INNER JOIN \`{db}\`.\`rawb2962af_1\` b ON a.row_id = b.row_id'''
print('DB', db)
df = fs.sql(sql, dataframe_type='pandas')
print('derived rows', len(df), list(df.columns))
print(df.head())
print('dtypes', df.dtypes.to_dict())
df.to_csv('.tmp_derived.csv', index=False)
" 2>&1 | grep -vE "^2026|INFO:|absl|http_proxy|WARNING: All|Reading data|Finished"
tool_input.description: Run join+round on platform via fs.sql

tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && python -c "
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
fga = fs.get_feature_group('rawa2962af', version=1)
fgb = fs.get_feature_group('rawb2962af', version=1)

# Platform-side inner join via Hopsworks Feature Query Service
q = fga.select_all().join(fgb.select(['b_val']), on=['row_id'], join_type='inner')
df = q.read()
print('joined rows', len(df), list(df.columns))
df['col_sum'] = (df['a_val'] + df['b_val']).round(6)
out = df[['row_id','col_sum']].copy()
print('derived rows', len(out))
print(out.head())

fgd = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='derived2962af', version=1,
    description='row_ids present in both rawa2962af and rawb2962af; col_sum = a_val + b_val (rounded 6dp)',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    online_enabled=True,
    parents=[fga, fgb],
)
fgd.insert(out)
print('DERIVED CREATED', fgd.id)
out.to_csv('.tmp_derived.csv', index=False)
" 2>&1 | grep -vE "^2026|INFO:|absl|http_proxy|WARNING: All"
tool_input.description: Platform-side join, create derived FG with lineage and online enabled

import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
import hopsworks
proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()
fgd = fs.get_feature_group('derived2962af', version=1)
print('online_enabled', fgd.online_enabled)
# Lineage / provenance
try:
    parents = fgd.get_parent_feature_groups()
    names = sorted({p.name for p in parents.accessible}) if hasattr(parents,'accessible') else None
    print('PARENTS accessible', names)
    print('parents raw', parents)
except Exception as e:
    print('parents err', repr(e)[:300])
# Online read test
try:
    sel = fgd.select_all()
    df = sel.read(online=True)
    print('ONLINE rows', len(df), df.head(3).to_dict('records'))
except Exception as e:
    print('online read err', repr(e)[:300])
" 2>&1 | grep -vE "^2026|INFO:|absl|http_proxy|WARNING: All|Reading data|Finished"
